title: Airflow: scheduling, sensors, backfill and catch-up

videos.script: Ana unpauses her DAG and lets the scheduler decide. The first run it makes loads a day in October. The shop lives in March. The run succeeds, and loads nothing. {{empty}} Then she turns catch-up on for a DAG with an old start date. Two hundred and nineteen runs appear in twenty seconds. {{flood}} So she fills the past on purpose, with a backfill. Half of the runs fail. They all ran at once, and they all rebuild the same tables. {{collide}} One run at a time, and every day of the week is loaded. {{serial}} A sensor waits for the distributor's file, and lets the load run the moment it lands. {{sensor}} And a report runs whenever the fact table changes, with no clock in it at all. {{asset}} Last, the lab's fast clock. Every minute of the machine's time, one more day of the shop's. Four minutes, four days, and the scheduler kept time.
